## What it is

Jabhook is an app for boxing training. Build a custom workout, follow spoken combinations, and get real-time coaching based on your movement. Use it for bagwork or shadowboxing.

## Jabhook for Mac

- Apple Silicon Mac

- macOS 26.2 or later

- Webcam or iPhone

Questions? johnny@jabhook.ai

## Technology

- Motion capture Computer vision estimates your movement in 3D. ↓

### Motion capture

Computer vision estimates your movement in 3D.

- Biomechanics analysis Your movement is compared with a reference library of combinations recorded in collaboration with a professional boxer. ↓

### Biomechanics analysis

Your movement is compared with a reference library of combinations recorded in collaboration with a professional boxer.

- Spoken coaching A local large language model (LLM) turns the analysis into spoken coaching cues.

### Spoken coaching
